stories.story_fr: Solventum a annoncé la vente de son activité Purification & Filtration à Thermo Fisher Scientific le 25 février 2025, transaction finalisée le 1er septembre 2025.
stories.story_en: Solventum announced the sale of its Purification & Filtration business to Thermo Fisher Scientific on Feb. 25, 2025, with the transaction closed on Sept. 1, 2025.
stories.quote: Announced the sale of the Purification & Filtration business to Thermo Fisher Scientific on Feb. 25, 2025

stories.story_fr: Lancement du Filtek™ Composite Warmer, premier dispositif restauratif entièrement brandé Solventum.
stories.story_en: Launch of the Filtek™ Composite Warmer, the first fully Solventum‑branded restorative device.
stories.quote: Launched Filtek™ composite warmer, the first fully Solventum-branded restorative device

stories.story_fr: Croissance forte du revenu provenant de la gestion du cycle de facturation, moteur clé de la performance.
stories.story_en: Strong growth in revenue cycle management, a key performance driver.
stories.quote: Strong growth in revenue cycle management

stories.story_fr: Adoption élargie de la solution 360 Encompass™ dans les systèmes d’information santé.
stories.story_en: Expanded adoption of the 360 Encompass™ solution in health information systems.
